source.method: User official SVG export of previously selected redXL Processing loader

comparison.colorTreatment: Existing red/black and reverse outline CSS uses brightness(0) invert(1); dark neutral retained for other surfaces.

decision: No contour rewrite or global white substitution. Original exported bytes preserved. Duplicate source paths and color treatment are explicit; pixel-level antialiasing and animation are not certified.
scope: Exact contour correspondence to selected red42 regular source; not all loaders/variants or whole Button acceptance.
verification: XML parsed, both source paths compared to runtime d, viewBox and dimensions matched; no browser/network tests.
